notes: πρὸς τὸ μὴ ἐπιβαρῆσαι is analysed under rule 61: the preposition takes the clause-introducer that, the article is unrepresented, and the modal and supplied subject ride with the infinitive under rule 74.
Three articles are unrepresented on three distinct grounds — displacement (s004), no determiner written (s008, s025), and the articular infinitive (s015).
τινα is rendered non-negatively as any, so under rule 69 the negation stays on μή.
